title: The peace accords in Central America
goal: I can tell the steps of the peace process in order, using primero, luego, después and al final.

items: I can put the steps of the peace process in order with primero, luego, después and al final.
I can say who won the elections in Nicaragua in 1990.
I can say when the war ended in El Salvador and in Guatemala.
I can say what the peace agreements did not solve, and whose view that is.
I can use the new words for agreement, elections and candidate.
